Resume 2’s volume audit fails against full inputs; its temporary filtered-input pass does not close compatibility. Resume 3 subsequently uses the volume-aware driver and validates/selects 41/285/1,130 volume-one steps in the respective routes. Resume 4 adds 31 body/two ability rows, skips 167 identical rows and retains 54 differing RV2/RV7 conflicts under row-over-gap/later-equal-kind resolution. Controls rise to 26/210/285 in the three mappings, but remain candidate command IDs without eligibility/settlement/browser/save proof. Old category exclusions remain gaps with metadata in that scorer. An unresolved small accounting discrepancy is retained: the initial added-kind table sums to 12 while its merge-check line reports 11 added rows; no private merger receipt was reopened to resolve it. Exact identities, later replacements and failures stay chronological rather than flattened into a single success count.
